observed_failures: Credential namespace cleanup originally rejected an empty suffix; restricted namespace enumeration fixed and rerun with cleanup before PASS.
Native forget-password fixture selected a hidden Typora dialog; scoped to the actual accessible dialog and rerun.

Opening the remote picker immediately after the first context event raced unfinished connection/workspace transition; active provider now commits only in shared folder transaction and connect awaits that transaction. Native full workspace rerun passed.
UI runner rejected a nonexistent test filename before execution; corrected to test_workspace_switch.cjs, all five suites passed.
Keyboard fixture omitted Chromium char event; complete Return/char/keyUp sequence passed without product key-handler changes.
Review found that automatic legacy-login migration could refill a reset viewing vault; migration now writes the login domain only, with a coordinator regression and final native rerun.
boundaries: Real host validation uses one Linux SSH account and original Typora 1.14.10 on current Windows; other account/port identities are verified through real ssh -G and isolated contracts, not additional real accounts.
No claim of physical Windows 10 or all DPI/remote OS verification; Windows Credential Manager is the implemented persistent-secret backend.
Records are shared across windows with atomic file locking; each window owns its active identity. Complete remote session restoration remains outside this delivery.
Viewing password protects application viewing records, not other software already running as the same Windows user. Reset preserves auto-login credentials.
User windows were not restarted. Save documents and restart normally to load installed assets.
Unedited-save-warning issue remains deferred by user; existing draft protection is retained.
